name: USA Wire & Cable, Inc.
old_description: USA Wire & Cable, Inc. is a global distributor of electrical wire and cable serving all 50 states and shipping to more than 50 countries. With more than 250 years of combined experience, our personnel have the cable knowledge and experience needed to provide the specification review service relied upon by many of the top engineering and construction firms worldwide.
about:
USA Wire & Cable, Inc. was founded in 1990 in Austin, Texas, by Joe Navarro, who remains president. The privately held company began as a distributor of specialty industrial wire and cable and has grown into a global supplier serving all 50 states and more than 50 countries.

The company distributes a broad range of electrical wire and cable products, including instrumentation, thermocouple, control, tray cable, portable power, medium voltage, armored cable, single conductor, and substation cable. Operations are centered at a corporate office and main distribution warehouse in Central Texas, with additional distribution centers in Texas and cable management staging locations coast to coast, enabling delivery to any U.S. job site within 48 hours. The firm also provides specification review services, cable cutting, rewinding, and inventory management for customers.

USA Wire & Cable serves utilities, mining, construction, manufacturing, defense, government, oil and gas, and education sectors. Its specification review service is relied upon by top engineering and construction firms worldwide, and the company has supplied over 100 power plant projects. Customers include major engineering firms, contractors, and government agencies that require rapid turnaround and technical expertise.

The company emphasizes its relationships with high-quality American manufacturers, its commitment to U.S.-made products, and its role in supporting domestic infrastructure. It positions itself as a master wire and cable distributor that adds value by helping clients avoid costly errors through deep product knowledge and supply chain management.
